A: Panel A shows H&E stained tissue from a biopsy revealing erosions and a severe inflammatory infiltrate, consistent with the target disease pathology. B: Panel B shows H&E stained tissue with large lymphocytes, describing the cellular composition of the mucocutaneous ulcer. D: Panel D shows IHC staining positive for CD3 on small T cells, illustrating the specific immune cell infiltrate characteristic of the diagnosis. E: Panel E shows IHC staining positive for CD20 on B cells, providing critical evidence for the cellular makeup and immune reaction in the EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer. F: Panel F demonstrates IHC staining positive for CD30 on large lymphocytes, further defining the specific cellular infiltrate associated with the mucocutaneous ulcer.
